changes.text: The `inline` variant shows a 1px underline at rest (it was hidden until hover or focus), so a link in running text is not told apart by colour alone. It still thickens to 2px with the glow on hover and `:focus-visible`.

`rel="noopener noreferrer"` and the "(opens in a new tab)" screen-reader hint follow the real `target`: an explicit `target="_blank"` gets both, and an external link forced to `target="_self"` drops the hint. The external icon still follows `external`.
A custom `rel` is merged with `noopener noreferrer` on links that open a new tab, without duplicates. Before, a custom `rel` replaced them.
`.ss-link` cancels the global `a::before` underline from `theme.css`, so only one underline shows and the link looks the same with or without `theme.css`. The underline is placed with `inset-inline`.

New `disabled` prop: the link drops its `href`, `target` and `rel`, leaves the tab order, keeps `role="link"` with `aria-disabled="true"`, and does not fire `onclick`. It gets the `disabled` class (dimmed, `not-allowed` cursor) and shows no external icon or underline.

New component: an anchor with an animated underline and `--ss-primary` glow (`variant="inline"`) or a solid primary button look (`variant="button"`). `external` (auto-detected for absolute `http(s)` and protocol-relative URLs) opens a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, an external icon and a screen-reader hint; it also takes `size` and a bindable `el`.
